description: This file defines the class SearchQueryWhereDelegate, which implements the SearchQueryWhereStep interface for building search queries using Hibernate Search. It provides methods to set search predicates for a query, augmenting the delegate SearchQueryWhereStep with additional predicate logic, along with optional final predicates.

classes.name: SearchQueryWhereDelegate
classes.description: An internal class implementing SearchQueryWhereStep, facilitating the addition of search predicates with optional finalization.
